channel.title: Women's Wear Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Chanel Opens Seasonal Boutique in Aspen
item.description: The 2,693-square-foot, two-level store features ready-to-wear, accessories, leather goods and shoes, as well as watches and fine jewelry.

item.title: Inside Nordstrom’s Powerful Merchandising Formula
item.description: How the retailer combines powerful storytelling with top-notch service to meet the demands of both brands and consumers.

item.title: How Nordstrom Is Reimagining Service in the Digital Age and Beyond
item.description: Heads of the brick-and-mortar and digital facets of the business talk ensuring high-service continuity as shoppers interact with the retailer.

item.title: The Answers Are on the Floor: How Nordstrom Sustains Its Reputation for Customer Service
item.description: Nordstrom employees explain how they connect with customers.

item.title: The Nordstroms on Going Private, Liverpool and What Lies Ahead
item.description: Co-CEOs Erik and Pete Nordstrom open up on how at their 125-year-old business, there's change and continuity as the Nordstrom and Rack brands evolve.

item.title: How Nordstrom Is Bringing Its Brand to Life to Mark 125 Years
item.description: Consumers can expect a large slate of unique brand activations, campaigns and special perks for loyalty members.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Bonpoint and Porsche Have Made the Perfect Outfits for Baby Drivers
item.description: The capsule collection of clothes and accessories is inspired by the German sports car manufacturer's legendary 911 model.

item.title: Balenciaga Appoints New Global Communications Director
item.description: Francesca Nardi previously worked for many years at Valentino, and also Burberry.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Hublot Taps BTS’ Jung Kook as Global Ambassador
item.description: The South Korean musical artist's appointment comes as attention is reaching a fever pitch around BTS’ long-awaited reunion, kicking off with a concert on March 21 in Seoul.

item.title: Nordstrom Rack Expands Footprint, Competes on Brand Selection and Pricing
item.description: Rack's ability to help off-price shoppers discover new premium brands enables it to be a pipeline for new customers to full-line Nordstrom stores.
